h1: The 5 Best Full-Size Murphy Beds with Desks of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Full Murphy Beds with Desks: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 5 best full-size Murphy beds with desks of 2026, compared on mattress inclusion, storage, finish and price for small rooms.
mainKeyword: full size murphy bed with desk
summary: The AFI Northampton is the best overall because the mattress is included. The white MERITLINE is the cheapest confirmed desk combo, the grey MERITLINE adds a bookcase, the Merax packs the most storage, and the THINK 30 offers the most distinctive finish.
intro: The costly Murphy bed surprise is the mattress. Many cabinets are sold without one, and a standard full mattress is often too thick to close inside the frame, so you end up buying a slim model anyway. Check whether a mattress is included and what thickness the cabinet takes before comparing anything else.

We reviewed Murphy beds with a desk on paper, comparing mattress inclusion, storage, finish and price tier from the listings. Only five listings were genuine full size beds with a built in desk, so this ranking has five picks. Review data on several is thin, and we say so.

products.name: AFI Northampton Full Murphy Bed Desk with Memory Foam 6 Inch Mattress
products.verdict: The mattress is included, so the bed closes properly.
products.description:
The Northampton is a full size Murphy bed with a fold down desk and a 6 inch memory foam mattress included, in a white finish. AFI sells it as an assembled cabinet.

It ranks first because the mattress is sized for the cabinet, which removes the biggest source of buying mistakes. The tradeoff is price: it sits in the $500 and up tier, well above the MERITLINE.

Buy it if you want one purchase to cover bed, desk and mattress. A 6 inch mattress is firm and thin, so heavy sleepers should check comfort.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a one box solution.

products.name: MERITLINE Full Murphy Bed with Desk, Wood Folding Hideaway Space Saving Wall Bed
products.verdict: The lowest priced confirmed full size desk combo.
products.description:
This MERITLINE is a full size wood cabinet in white with a fold down desk, in the $200 to $500 tier.

It ranks second because it costs far less than the AFI, though the review base is thin and no mattress is listed as included. Expect to buy a slim mattress separately.

Choose it for a solo sleeper on a budget. Confirm the mattress thickness the frame takes before ordering.

products.name: MERITLINE Full Murphy Bed with Desk and Storage Shelves, Grey
products.verdict: Desk plus bookcase storage in a grey finish.
products.description:
This MERITLINE full size cabinet pairs a fold down desk with storage shelves and a bookcase in a grey wood finish. No price tier was available.

It ranks third because the added shelving suits a room that needs storage, but review data is limited, and the white MERITLINE has a confirmed lower price.

Pick it if you want the desk and a bookcase in one footprint.

products.name: Merax Full Size Wall Murphy Bed with Desk, Top Cabinet and Storage Shelves
products.verdict: A top cabinet and shelves for the most storage.
products.description:
The Merax is a full size wooden wall bed with a fold down desk, a top cabinet and storage shelves, in the $500 and up tier.

It ranks fourth because it holds the most storage, but it costs more than the MERITLINE and has only a single low rating on file, so research current reviews closely.

Choose it for a small room that needs wall storage and a desk together.

products.name: THINK 30 Murphy Bed with Foldable Desk, Full Size, Walnut and Gray
products.verdict: A walnut and gray look with a separate desk hinge.
products.description:
The THINK 30 is a full size cabinet with a foldable desk, a walnut and gray finish and a separate desk fold hinge mechanism, in the $500 and up tier.

It ranks last because it costs as much as the AFI without a listed mattress, and review data is limited and middling.

Buy it if the finish is the deciding factor.

whatMatters.detail: A Murphy bed closes with the mattress inside, so the frame limits thickness. A 6 inch memory foam mattress fits, but a 12 inch one may not. Check the maximum mattress depth in the specs.
A full bed folds down roughly 54 inches wide and about 75 inches long. Measure the floor space it needs in use. Check ceiling height against the cabinet.
A fold down desk must be cleared before the bed opens. Items on it will fall. Look for how the desk folds in the listing.
A Murphy bed must be fixed to wall studs for safety. Check the hardware list. Never skip anchoring.
Shelves and top cabinets add storage but also weight and cost. Choose what you will use.

faq.a: Only on the AFI Northampton, which has a 6 inch memory foam mattress. The others list none.
Ignoring mattress thickness. A thick mattress may stop the bed from closing.

faq.q: Is the AFI worth it over the MERITLINE?
faq.a: If you need a mattress, yes. If you own a slim one, MERITLINE saves money.
The AFI is sold as an assembled cabinet. The others may need assembly, so check.
Check the hinges and wall anchors periodically.

faq.q: Can I leave things on the desk?
faq.a: No. Clear it before folding the bed, or items will fall.

finalTake: The AFI Northampton is the simplest complete purchase, and the white MERITLINE is the budget way in. Choose the grey MERITLINE or Merax for storage and the THINK 30 for finish. Verify mattress fit and anchor it to studs.
